constraints.definition: CHECK (((jsonb_typeof(quote) = 'object'::text) AND (quote ?& ARRAY['monthly_price'::text, 'inbound_per_minute'::text, 'currency'::text]) AND (jsonb_typeof((quote -> 'monthly_price'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((quote -> 'inbound_per_minute'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((quote -> 'currency'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((quote ->> 'monthly_price'::text) ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,11})(\.[0-9]{1,8})?$'::text) AND ((quote ->> 'inbound_per_minute'::text) ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,11})(\.[0-9]{1,8})?$'::text) AND ((quote ->> 'currency'::text) ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'::text)))

CHECK ((((state = 'quoted'::text) AND (request_id IS NULL) AND (attempted_at IS NULL) AND (provider_sid IS NULL) AND (phone_number_id IS NULL)) OR ((state = 'failed_before_purchase'::text) AND (request_id IS NOT NULL) AND (attempted_at IS NULL) AND (provider_sid IS NULL) AND (phone_number_id IS NULL)) OR ((state = ANY (ARRAY['purchasing'::text, 'needs_review'::text])) AND (request_id IS NOT NULL) AND (attempted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (provider_sid IS NULL) AND (phone_number_id IS NULL)) OR ((state = 'purchased_pending_save'::text) AND (request_id IS NOT NULL) AND (attempted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (provider_sid IS NOT NULL) AND (receipt_recorded_at IS NOT NULL) AND (phone_number_id IS NULL)) OR ((state = 'completed'::text) AND (request_id IS NOT NULL) AND (attempted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (provider_sid IS NOT NULL) AND (receipt_recorded_at IS NOT NULL) AND (phone_number_id IS NOT NULL) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL))))
